reviews.title: Great Overall motherboard
reviews.comment:
Really happy with this board. Looks clean in my build (love the white), and it's been running my AM5 setup with zero issues so far. BIOS was easy to figure out, EXPO turned on with one click, and my RAM is running at full speed no problem.

WiFi 7 is fast, the USB4 port is a nice bonus, and installing the GPU was way easier with the quick release button. Stays cool too, even when I'm gaming for hours.

Wish it had one more fan header but that's really my only complaint. Good board for the price, would buy again.
reviews.author: Nathan

reviews.title: Great Purchase.
reviews.comment: Excellent Motherboard, I love the way it looks and certainly performs well. I ran into an issue trying to connect to the internet. I had to download the drivers on a diff computer into a thumb drive and upload them so the Ethernet port would work in order to update everything. You will have to go to the Asus website and get all the motherboard drivers from there. You do this and you will have zero issues. Good luck!

reviews.title: Not the boards fault
reviews.comment:
Its a great mobo if you buy new or luck out on a open box,
Turns out im like the 3rd to buy this board as "excellent" open box by the stickers on it, so i immediately checked and yep bent CPU pins dead channel A by pin out. Their QC needs to inspect better before marking a open box as excellent.
